items.title: Reddit’s (RDDT) Short-Term Pains May Lead to Long-Term Gains
items.summary: Reddit’s (RDDT) short-term pains may lead to long-term gains, in my view. The leading social media platform lost more than 25% of its market value soon after it reported Q3 earnings on October 30. This crash followed traffic headwinds from Google’s (GOOGL) AI Overviews and the rollout of its new artificial intelligence (AI) Mode features, which negatively impacted Reddit’s user growth. items.title: Reddit (RDDT) Highlights 1,300 Gaming Communities For Marketers
items.summary: Reddit (NYSE: RDDT) is spotlighting its 1,300 gaming related communities as a key channel for video game marketers. The company shared new data on how gaming discussions on the platform influence discovery, engagement, and purchase decisions for titles and hardware. Reddit is pointing to improved advertising results for gaming brands and a rising share of the gaming ad market since 2023. items.title: Reddit Sinks 8% as Social Ad Worries Deepen in Tech Rout
items.summary: Key TakeawaysReddit shares fell 8% today after Snap reported just 4% ad revenue growth, in a broad tech selloff. Meta’s 26% revenue growth last quarter suggests advertisers are still spending on the biggest social platform, so Snap’s slowdown looks like Snap’s own problem.
